services.desc: With its alluring mix of iconic automobiles and classic Mid-Century furniture, the 80,000 square-foot Newport Car Museum creates a fascinating backdrop for corporate events and meetings. The 1800 sq. ft. Wheel Room, with its state-of-the-art audio/visual capabilities and easily configurable seating and table arrangements, allows for conference or social-style settings for 75-100 people. Open Daily 10 a.m. - 5 p.m. Closed: Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, New Year’s Day (and at 2 p.m. the days prior) 1947 West Main Road Portsmouth, Rhode Island 02871 Email:
